description: Find youth sports clubs in the Hat Trick Local directory by name, town, state or distance (the listings today are soccer clubs). Use it whenever a person names a club, even vaguely or misspelled: when no listing matches every word, the answer lists candidates with similar names. Each result has the club's org_key (for get_club and the link tools), its town, whether registration is open or upcoming with dates and source, its fee range and how its facts were verified. Coverage is Ohio and Pennsylvania first; no result elsewhere means not in this directory, not that no club exists.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous answer, for the next page of the same search.

near.description: A 5-digit US ZIP code, or latitude,longitude, to search by distance. Results then carry distance_mi.

query.description: Club name, part of a name or a town. Every word must match; when nothing does, similar names come back as candidates.

registration_open.description: true: only clubs whose registration is open today.

registration_status.description: open (today), upcoming (a window starts later) or not_on_record.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, for example OH or PA.

name: search_clubs
title: Search clubs
